lesson_yaml:
schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: java-nifi-controller-service-groovy-missing-restricted-execute-code
title: NiFi controller service uses Groovy but lacks @Restricted EXECUTE_CODE permission
summary: A NiFi controller service that compiles or evaluates Groovy (GroovyShell/GroovyClassLoader) is
  not annotated with @Restricted using RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE. Without the restriction, any user
  permitted to configure controller services can cause NiFi to run arbitrary code, bypassing the authorization
  intended for code-execution components.
cwe:
- CWE-862
- CWE-94
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: 72fab7dde74edfd1063b57e87b0334340c1fbe93
  vulnerable_ref: 72fab7dde74edfd1063b57e87b0334340c1fbe93^
  patched_ref: 72fab7dde74edfd1063b57e87b0334340c1fbe93
  repository: https://github.com/apache/nifi
rule:
  message: This controller service class uses Groovy scripting but the file declares no @Restricted annotation
    with RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE, so unprivileged users who can configure it can execute arbitrary
    code.
  pattern-regex: (?s)\A(?!.*RequiredPermission\.EXECUTE_CODE)(?=.*\bextends\s+AbstractControllerService\b)(?=.*\b(?:GroovyShell|GroovyClassLoader)\b).*
fix:
  guidance: Annotate the controller service class with @Restricted and a @Restriction using RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE
    together with an explanation, so only users granted the "execute code" restricted permission can configure
    it.
  example: "@RequiresInstanceClassLoading\n@Restricted(\n        restrictions = {\n                @Restriction(\n\
    \                        requiredPermission = RequiredPermission.EXECUTE_CODE,\n                 \
    \       explanation = \"Enables configuration of scripted queries\"\n                )\n        }\n\
    )\npublic class TinkerpopClientService extends AbstractControllerService implements GraphClientService\
    \ {\n}\n"
